disclosures.title: Brotli decoder vulnerability
disclosures.summary: Crafted Brotli-compressed data can corrupt memory and allow remote code execution in software that decodes untrusted Brotli data.
disclosures.mitigation: Update to a fixed release. Until then, reject Brotli (Content-Encoding: br) before any decoder runs, disable automatic Brotli decompression in HTTP clients, and pause untrusted Brotli file processing.

disclosures.title: php2shell: critical PHP vulnerabilities
disclosures.summary: Two PHP engine flaws can let unauthenticated attackers execute code as the PHP worker.
disclosures.mitigation: Upgrading PHP is the only complete fix. Restart PHP-FPM, Apache and long-running workers after upgrading.
